_readme: ComfyUI workflow templates (API format), grounded against the live /object_info of ComfyUI 0.24.0 on 2026-07-09. ComfyClient patches nodes by _meta.title using the 'patchable' maps below (title -> node_id.input_field). Every template must pass `model_lab test-workflows` after any node-pack change. Checkpoint names default to PATCH placeholders because image_primary (krea2) is not on disk yet and the MODEL BAN LIST forbids the local SDXL anime checkpoints.

scene_plate.json.purpose: One location master plate per scene (no characters) - the background consistency anchor

panel_txt2img.json.purpose: Per-shot panel: base + speed LoRA + style LoRA + <=2 character LoRAs + dual IPAdapter (char ref, scene plate)
panel_txt2img.json.notes: Disable an unused char LoRA by patching its strengths to 0. Disable plate conditioning by patching IPA_PLATE_WEIGHT to 0.

panel_img2img_lastframe.json.purpose: Block-opening shot conditioned on previous block's last frame (composition continuity)

character_sheet.json.purpose: 360-degree turnaround / expression / pose reference frames (Stage 1R). VIEW instruction goes inside PROMPT_POS.
character_sheet.json.notes: Uses il_anime_model_turn LoRA (SDXL-family). If krea2 is a different architecture, M4 must retrain/replace this LoRA - see design 5.3b.

mouth_sheet.json.purpose: Inpaint the mouth region of a character's front ref into one viseme shape (run 9x per character)
mouth_sheet.json.notes: Pipeline pre-renders the mask PNG (white mouth bbox on black) and uploads both images.

ltx_ambient.json.purpose: Tier-1 ambient motion: image-to-video from the shot panel, core ComfyUI LTX nodes
ltx_ambient.json.notes: FPS patched into both LTXVConditioning.frame_rate and SaveAnimatedWEBP.fps; RIFE conforms to project fps afterwards.

ltx_director.json.purpose: Tier-2 action motion with first+last frame conditioning (LTXVAddGuide at frame_idx -1)

wan_ti2v.json.purpose: Tier-2 alternate: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B fp8, 20 steps unipc, block-swap 20, cfg 5.0, 81f@16fps
wan_ti2v.json.notes: WanVideoWrapper node signatures change across kijai releases - build this by exporting a working graph from the UI at M4, keeping the titles: WAN_MODEL, WAN_VAE, START_FRAME, MOTION_PROMPT, SEED, BLOCK_SWAP, SAVE_PREFIX.

lora_dataset_prep.json.purpose: WD14 captioning over a ref folder for LoRA datasets
lora_dataset_prep.json.notes: Requires comfyui-wd14-tagger install (design 5.3b item 2). Outfit-token injection happens in pipeline code after captioning.
